cpmplus.w7rig.menu.bend.desc: Splits an arm, a leg or the body in two so the lower part can bend, without changing the skin
cpmplus.w7rig.menu.curve.desc: Turns the selected cube into a chain of slices that follows an arc
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.title: Bendable limbs
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.intro: Pick the parts. Each one becomes two: the upper one still follows the shoulder / hip as before, the lower one turns at the elbow / knee. The skin stays exactly the same. Ctrl+Z undoes everything.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.cut: Where it bends (px from the shoulder / hip)
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.cut.desc: Whole texture rows only. 6 = the middle of a 12 px limb.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.dir.auto: The usual way (arms and waist forward, legs backward)
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.dir.desc: The joint sits on the outer edge of the cut, so that side stays closed when it bends
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.layer.desc: The 2nd layer is split too, without overlapping at the cut. If the game drew the sleeve, it becomes a model cube (then it always shows, even with sleeves turned off in the skin options).
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.item.desc: The hand item slot moves into the forearm (it is created when missing), so the item follows the bend
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.below: Take along the parts below the cut: %s
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.limits: Good to know: vanilla armor does not bend (it follows the whole part). Minecraft's walk only swings the whole part; the elbow / knee only bends in your animations.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.testToast: Click here to see the bend move (preview only, nothing is saved)
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.warn.cutMoved: A cut at %s px does not land on a whole texture row; it is at %s px.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.warn.slotRotated: The hand item slot is inside a rotated group; it stayed where it was.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.animate: Go back to Edit mode first (this changes the model's parts).
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.notLimb: '%s' is not an arm, a leg or the body.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.noRoot: %s: part not found in the model.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.selectedOutside: The selected cube is not directly inside %s.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.rotated: %s: the cube is rotated, it cannot be split without changing the skin.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.mesh: %s: the part is a mesh, not a cube.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.extrude: %s: extruded sprite cubes cannot be split.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.noCube: %s: the part's cube is not at its normal place / size. Select the cube you want to split and try again.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.ambiguous: %s: %s cubes look like the part. Select the one you want to split and try again.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.ambiguousLayer: %s: there is more than one 2nd layer cube. Turn the 2nd layer option off or keep only one.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.layerInflate: %s: the 2nd layer is %s px thicker; that cannot be split without a gap in game. Turn the 2nd layer option off.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.height: %s: the cube height is not a whole number of pixels.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.faceRot: %s: a side face has its UV rotated 90 degrees; it cannot be split safely.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.noGridCut: %s: no cut lands on whole texture rows.
cpmplus.w7rig.bend.err.none: No part can be split right now (see the reason of each one).
cpmplus.w7rig.unbend.title: Undo bendable limb
cpmplus.w7rig.unbend.confirm: Join '%s' back into a single cube?
cpmplus.w7rig.unbend.confirmAnims: These animations move '%s' and will lose that movement: %s. Join anyway?
cpmplus.w7rig.unbend.err.noMark: This group has no bendable limb information (it was made another way, or the model went through a .cpmproject). Use Ctrl+Z or redo it by hand.
cpmplus.w7rig.unbend.err.moved: The joint was moved out of the body part; it cannot be joined automatically.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.title: Curve part
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.intro: The cube becomes a chain of slices, each one turned a little, like a skirt, a cape, hair or a tail. Each slice is a group you can animate. Ctrl+Z (or Cancel) gives the cube back.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.dir.desc: The tip of the part moves to this side
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.slices.desc: Only some numbers keep the texture on whole pixels; the status below lists them
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.close.desc: Each slice gets a little longer at the joints so the outer side has no gap (the texture stretches a bit there)
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.done: curved into %s slices (outer gap %s px per joint)
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.validN: Slices that keep the texture on whole pixels: %s
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.closed: Gaps closed: each slice gets %s px longer at its joints.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.gapHint: Use %s slices to stay below 0.25 px, or turn on 'Close the gaps'.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.centerWarn: Joint in the middle: the inner side overlaps and may flicker (z-fighting).
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.realAngle: In game the total angle is %s degrees (angles are rounded a little).
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.colourOnly: Solid colour cube: any slice count works.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.honest: With cubes a curve always has small gaps or overlaps at the joints; this shows them as they are.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.oneCube: Select exactly one cube to curve.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.notCube: This only works on a normal cube (not a mesh).
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.extrude: Extruded sprite cubes cannot be curved.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.rotated: The cube has its own rotation. Put it into its own group first (move the rotation to the group), then curve it.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.flat: The cube has no length along that axis.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.noMesh: The cube is not shown in the viewport yet; make it visible and try again.
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.invalidN: This number of slices would break the UV (the texture would not land on whole pixels).
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.tooMany: At most 12 slices (longer chains weigh on the timeline and the model).
cpmplus.w7rig.curve.err.sizeGrid: The cube size (with its inflate) is not on the 0.1 px grid CPM uses, so slices would leave gaps in game.
